statement: agp-Cockpit is the owner's private tool and is not published to package indexes. A release is: version bump, changelog entry, annotated git tag, a local app build and a GitHub Release entry in the private repository (visible only to the owner). The entry is created by the Kit's signed release run (kit_github_release, owner 2026-10-05, P11c; active since 2026-10-08 with Kit 1.0.20). No PyPI package, no Zenodo record. No Zenodo record exists for this repository; none may be created, updated or queried. Cockpit work orders never create, edit or delete GitHub Releases themselves.
allowed: annotated git tag (pushing it is a remote effect and needs the owner's approval)
GitHub Release entry in the private repository: by the Kit's signed release run (kit_github_release, publication: github)

tag_push.condition: after the owner's approval of the release run

owner_github_release.by: the owner, by hand (gh release create --verify-tag)
owner_github_release.condition: repository stays private; the tag exists; no Zenodo integration enabled for the repository

signed_kit_commands.rule: The Kit's release route (Kit 1.0.16, KIT-GF-038; GitHub entry since Kit 1.0.17, KIT-GF-043): the dry run is free and prints an approval signature; the live run needs --execute --allow-execute --expected-signature <that signature> and the owner's approval; .agentic/config.yaml must declare the policy's publication (github: annotated tag plus GitHub Release entry, no PyPI or Zenodo); never the marker file .agentic/release/ENABLE_LIVE_PUBLISH.

kit_github_release.title: .agentic/config.yaml release.github_release_title_template
kit_github_release.notes: the CHANGELOG.md section of the version (AGP_RELEASE_CHANGELOG_GATE_V1 keeps it complete)
kit_github_release.condition: repository stays private; Kit >= 1.0.17 (KIT-GF-043); every pull request carries a release-note category (AGP_PR_RELEASE_CATEGORY_V1)
kit_github_release.status: active since 2026-10-08 (Kit 1.0.20; release.publish_checks: none because the Kit's command-reference check still runs a Kit-repository test here, KIT-GF-049 reproduced in 1.0.20)
kit_github_release.switch: done 2026-10-08: publication: github in .agentic/config.yaml and here, after a dry run of the GitHub route in a disposable clone

approval.rule: The owner's go (start click of the Release task, or the release named in a work order) covers every gate of that release, including irreversible publication (GitHub release; PyPI and DOI where a repository has them). The agent passes a gate only when its summary matches the consented release (version, tag, target commit) and the Kit's checks PASS; on FAIL, BLOCKED or any difference it stops.
